BiblicalUsage: Meraiah is a priest named among the chief of the fathers in the days of Joiakim. Nehemiah 12:12 lists him of Seraiah, in the register of the priests who served after the return.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the register keeps priests we know nothing else about, because faithful service is worth recording even when it is not worth a story.
